Validate or promote a source ingest job

Source: R/publish-source.R
soil_source_validate.Rd

The two server steps of soil_publish_source(), for a job uploaded with wait = FALSE.

Usage

soil_source_validate(soil = soil_session(), job_id)

soil_source_promote(soil = soil_session(), job_id)

Arguments

soil

A session; the default session when omitted. Client-side: not sent to the API.

job_id

The job id (or the result of a submission). API path parameter {job_id} of GET /jobs/{job_id} (also GET /publication-jobs/{job_id} and GET /soil-health-publication-jobs/{job_id}, by detail), POST /jobs/{job_id}/cancel and POST /source-ingests/{job_id}/validate or /promote.

Value

soil_source_validate(): a soil_source_validation list: job_id, valid, counts (staged records by type), errors (data frame: record_number, source_record_id, errors), diagnostics_truncated, unmapped_property_codes. soil_source_promote(): the soil_job (unified view), completed, with published_count, receipt_id and, in diagnostics, the release_id and the promoted counts.

Details

soil_source_validate() (POST /source-ingests/{job_id}/validate) stages the uploaded file and checks identities, hierarchy, geometry and observation declarations; it can be repeated while the job is validating. An invalid bundle is not an error here: the report has valid = FALSE, the rejected records in errors (at most 1,000, diagnostics_truncated), and the job fails.

soil_source_promote() (POST /source-ingests/{job_id}/promote) publishes a validated job in one transaction: provider, dataset, release (immutable: an existing release_code makes it fail), assets, canonical features, profiles, components, horizons and observations, coverage and receipt. Promoting a completed job returns it unchanged. A job that has not passed validation, or whose promotion is refused, is a soilhub_conflict_error (HTTP 409) explaining why.

Rights: soil:publish. Capability: source_ingest.

See also

Other writing: soil_product(), soil_product_version(), soil_publish_health(), soil_publish_source(), soil_publish_values(), soil_register_variable(), soil_run_open()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ingest <- soil_publish_source(soil, manifest, sites, idempotency_key = "k", wait = FALSE)
report <- soil_source_validate(soil, ingest$job_id)
report$unmapped_property_codes
if (report$valid) soil_source_promote(soil, ingest$job_id)
} # }
